source_instruction: i need an easy to carry tripod made of carbon fiber for my camera.
query:
Man, that hike I did last weekend up the pine ridge trail was so much wilder than I expected! I rounded a bend about two miles in and came face to face with a whole family of bighorn sheep just munching on scrub oak right off the path, and the baby one kept tilting its head at me like it was curious why I was huffing and puffing so bad up the incline. I stopped for a snack at the overlook halfway up and accidentally dropped my trail mix bar right into a patch of wild columbines, and before I could even grab it a bold little Steller’s jay swooped down and hauled the whole thing off to a nearby tree like it had pulled off the heist of the century. I ended up sitting there for twenty minutes just watching it peck at the bar and squawk at any other birds that tried to get close, it was way better entertainment than any podcast I had downloaded for the walk.
Hey, I’m looking for a tripod or monopod from this section made of fiberglass that’s easy to carry around, and I’d like one that comes with a detachable waterproof phone mount bundled in too. My budget is that usual amount I always stick to for camera gear, y’know? I don’t need any fancy extra tall extensions or anything, just something I can toss in my day bag when I’m out hiking to shoot landscape shots.
